reviews.comment: Houston is very strict about things, especially attendance even if you're not in your seat by the time class starts. It was assigned seating and groups. The tests are fill in the blank. He spent majority of class talking about random things. TA was amazing and helped. There was extra credit in the end which is how I got an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class blows.

I had Prof Houston for a 1 credit hour intro to ethics class. Attendance was not only mandatory, but if you are late by as little as 3 mins he expects you to meet with him after class to talk about how “5 mins early is late”. His exams are based on his slides and are composed of random sayings and proverbs you must know by heart to pass
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: While the class was hard, it was also one of the best classes I have had. Professor Houston cares, but only as much as you care about his class. He genuinely wants to see you do well, but he is exceptionally strict. His class is one of the ones I have learned the most in. If you want to actually learn, take Houston.

Do not take this guys class. He is not a good teacher. I took his class last year and it was nothing short of unbearable for me. He is one of those teachers that expects you to know material he doesn't teach. If I were u I would stay far away from him and his class. Do better as a teacher.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Do NOT take his 326. Just take it online while you can! He has unreal expectations and does not fully teach the assignments. He just expects you to know what he wants. This class is impossible and you don't learn anything.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: The review below is so short sited. You DO NOT need to be a licensed engineer to draw an ISO and size wire, those are both very valuable skills you should develop if you want to be a well-rounded construction professional. His class is hard but worth every bit of effort.

If you want to pretend to be an engineer, this is the class for you! Houston means well, but is teaching material is honestly for engineers. Our group projects focused on drawing iso's and sizing wire, two tasks that you need a LICENSED ENGINEER TO DO!
Get another job where you can't harm students
Just a very prejudice professor

Actually read the plumbing, mechanical, and electrical chapters in addition to showing up to class to take notes. People who don't read the book sweat their grade to the bitter end. offers tons of fluff assignments. Read the book, fill out unit guide and you'll be like me only needing a 0 on the final exam to make an A. and he loves God, always a +

Attendance isn't graded, but you won't pass if you don't show up. Great Christian guy who genuinely wants to get to know the students and instruct us as well as improve our spiritual well-being. Exams are tough, but he really cares about you as a person.

Phenomenal professor, these bad reviews are garbage. Best prof I've had. Houston is super passionate and cares a lot, and it shows through his teaching style. He'll teach you a lot, and all you have to do is go to class, take notes, and study. Great class, learned a ton, not to mention Houston is just a great guy who wants you to succeed

Between this in-person MEP 326 class and the online MEP 2 class taught by Carlson, the online class gets unlimited attempts at the vocabulary quizzes, no time limit on quizzes and exercises, and the exams are not proctored. The department lets you get an easy A if you decide to do the online class and pay the $750 distance education fee.
Horrible professor, horrible class.
Just awful.

I took this class with Estimating ll and it was not as challenging as people made it seem like. Lectures are filled with plenty of information as well as the exams, but nothing that is extremely hard. Assignments are such a grade booster, so you will be fine!! Houston is overall such an amazing prof. and you will learn a lot from him.

I do not really understand why his rating on here is so low. If you actually want to learn something about MEP, 325 and his capstone will be great classes for you. His class overall is not easy, but there should be no issue passing them. If you pay attention in class, and do the homework (some of which have easy extra credit), you should do fine.
Just go to class, that is all you have to do. Great guy, inspirational and cares.

This class gets a bad reputation. Professor Houston outlines at the start of the semester that his weekly assignment are the bulk of your grade. Haven't gotten above a 77 on an exam and will end the class with an A. Exams are difficult but doable. If you go to class and just pay attention, you'll be successful.

Houston is a tough grader but if you format your assignments correctly and do average on the tests you will get a solid B in this course. I have found him to be nothing but kind, he pushes you to go above and beyond what other professors require WHICH IS A GOOD THING. His content is helpful and practical for construction.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Ive had more support in high school than this dude I pay thousands of dollars to. I did the first 5 HW assignments wrong because there was a template on canvas that we were supposed to use for each HW. Long story short, after asking on canvas AND email what I'm doing wrong since the first HW he never replied so it was already too late at office hou

Professor Houston's tests are ridiculous and have no study material. Lectures are filled with power points with pictures and if you do not write down everything he says about the pictures you are done for when the test comes around. Each test are only a minute a question with complex questions. It blows my mind how he thinks this is learning.

Prof. Houston is more than willing to help you out in class and in life. Most students don't take the time to get to know him. If you read the book, you'll do better in his class. You'll have to work for an A, but you SHOULD have to work for an A. He is inspirational, practical, and respectful to those who deserve it. Don't expect a blow off class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very strict, disciplined, and sharp. He knows his stuff. When it comes to the classroom, he can showcase the information but, he cannot TEACH the information. I took his class in Spring of 2021. 47% got a C, 40% got a B, and 11% got an A. His class had 16 Q Drops. There were only 117 people. 16/117=14% of the overall class dropped his course...

He is a solid professor. His class is so easy and you can easily pass with a B with minimal effort. His exams are a little tough but definitely doable. I have probably put no more than 5 hours total studying for his exams throughout the whole semester and got a B (with no prior experience in the field). He is not great with feedback but he's solid.

I was really nervous to take this class with this professor based on the reviews listed on here. But I will say, this teacher is very knowledgeable and knows what he is talking about.I would say you get what you put into this class. He gives you plenty of chances to do well. The tests are not easy but feasible. I did learn tons from him.

A majority of the class would fail his tests, and he wouldn't even care. His lecture material has no correlation to the exams, and he posts zero study material, so it's basically just guessing. You could skip every lecture and still do the same on exams because the questions have almost no correlation. You will most likley get a C in his class.

Professor Houston doesn't believe in "There's no such thing as a dumb question." If you approach him, you need to understand what you're talking about or know how to explain what you're confused about. He is a very rigid man, and still carries the persona of an Army Officer. Speak respectfully and confidently to him and he will respect you back.

He started out on a good foot at the beginning. But, by the end of the semester all respect was gone. He will make you feel very little of yourself so be prepared to have thick skin when talking to him. For tests he never understands when 75% of the classes get below a B. Should be a sign that his way of teaching is not working.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I personally enjoyed prof houstons class but I know some of my classmates did not. You have to earn your grade in this class, its not particularly difficult but you get the grade you earn. He is very blunt and sometimes isnt the best when it comes to answering people questions. The class isnt that bad just be prepared to have to teach yourself.

Houston is unreal. He is still fairly new to teaching but that should not be an excuse for how bad his lectures translate into the tests. The tests are 50 questions in 50 minutes. In a normal class, this may not sound bad, but he has questions that consume time such as looking at multiple sheets of plans. I wish you good luck.

Houston gives in depth lectures and is happy to answer questions. He puts his lectures on eCampus before class, his homework's are worth a lot and are easy but very informative. He allows you to use any written or printed out notes that you have on the tests, making them very easy to excel on. AND, he does not require attendance.. though i would go
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Houston is my man! Greatest prof in cosc and is in the running for best at TAMU. This man is hilarious and will always keep lecture light hearted and fun! Don't forget to learn all you can about his mep PIPE because he will call you out if you don't know every square inch of it hehe
Great professor. This class is hard because you should probably know the material if this is your major and future job? Great guy.

Professor Houston is an incredible professor whose passion for his work and students is very evident in everything he does. Every bad report on here is probably from lazy people who just want everything handed to them. Take Houston if you can. You will learn so much more than another prof with an easy A.

Fantastic lectures. He was incredibly prepared and had a lot of knowledge about the subject. You could come into the class without any information about MEP systems and walk out well prepared to hold a good discussion in the field regarding these systems. Easy homework (photos of MEP items), easy exams if you go to class. Show up  Easy A.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Do not believe the hype. Professor Houston is a great proff, he genuinely cares about his students. Yes he is a hard grader and his tests are not the easiest, how ever it is all for a reason. His main focus is to prepare us for the industry. He will make you work to get an A, but overall he is a great professor.

reviews.comment: Overall class average is a 72 and he seems to think this is normal.

I would rather use sand paper as toilet paper than take this class again. Test material isn't impossible, but 105 questions in 50 min. becomes a test of how fast you can read not if you know the material or not. I would lick my own anus before I took this class again.

Only way I get through his lectures are if I pound a 30 rack of keystones in my truck at the rec parking lot before class. Test days I usually have to pound a handle of everclear to get halfway through his 105 question tests. You'll do better on the test if you randomly bubble your scantron before compared to actually taking the test.

Prof Houston is a disgrace to Texas A&M University. I'm disappointed in the program for selecting this man for the job. His expectations for his students is clearly impossible based on the results on assignments. Giving 105 question tests with only 50 minutes to take them is absolutely insane. 1 person in my class of 100 finished the test & 0 curve

His lectures can be valuable, but his terrible personality make class nearly unbearable. In all my years in education I have never seen a professor take time out of his day to ruin yours the same way he does.

This is a terrible professor!!! DO NOT TAKE. Literally everyone complains about this guy. Its his first semester at Tamu and I doubt he will last long. Terrible isnt even a word to justify how bad he is.
I would rather walk on a sea of legos all while listening to tanner talk about conspiracies than take this class again.

reviews.comment: Test questions are not hard, there's just a lot. The hw assignments people complain about are easy and I know many people who make good grades on them as long as you go talk to him on what he wants. Good teacher, interactive lectures, many opportunities to ask questions. I have never learned so much in class. It's his first year, he's learning.

I would rather cut my arm off than take this professor again. He is extremely unfair, took a class that used to be reasonably graded to something that we.. in his words "should be happy if we get a C." If you have any choice to take any other professor TAKE THE OTHER PROF!! Does not care if we pass or fail. RIP to my GPA.

reviews.comment: Impossible to make an A on any of his homework assignments. He actively looks for any minor mistake to dock points off your grades. He writes 105 question exams that you only have 50 mins to complete. Additionally, during your exam you have to fumble through sets of plans on the worlds tiniest desk. Very unhelpful during office hours.

Homework every week, which is supposed to be an easy completion grade but grades for unclear things that you are supposed to assume he wants. This class is supposed to be an easy B class for sure, probably even an easy A class but his power trip of being a first time professor makes him seem like he has to prove something.
